sources.title: MIT OpenCourseWare 18.102 Spring 2009, Lecture 24, Hermite Functions

contents.name: Lecture 24: completeness of the unweighted Hermite-function basis in Lebesgue L2
contents.reason: This is a related independent Hermite-basis treatment, but its functions and measure differ from normalized probabilists Hermite polynomials in Gaussian L2; no proof step here imports it.

sources.title: Tilmann Gneiting, Strictly and non-strictly positive definite functions on spheres

contents.name: Theorem 1: strict positive definiteness criteria for isotropic kernels on spheres, with separate circle and higher-dimensional cases

contents.name: Sphere conventions and the coefficient criterion used in the source discussion
